gloss: items resolved; matters decided by vote

definitions.gloss: items resolved; matters decided by vote; resolutions
definitions.explanation: Specific items or matters that have been formally decided upon through a vote or resolution, typically in a meeting, assembly, or legislative body. A standard term in parliamentary and corporate governance.

examples.japanese: {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{決議事項|けつぎじこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧だ。
examples.english: There are three items for resolution at the shareholders' meeting.

examples.japanese: {決議事項|けつぎじこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{報告事項|ほうこくじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Resolutions and report items are recorded separately in the minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{決議事項|けつぎじこう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げられた→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧。
examples.english: This term's budget proposal was taken up last on the agenda as the most important item for resolution.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧ (resolution, vote) and ⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ (items, matters). A formal administrative and legal term used in meeting agendas, corporate governance, and legislative proceedings.

USAGE:
In Japanese corporate law, shareholders' meetings ({株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}) have specific {決議事項|けつぎじこう} that require a formal vote, as opposed to {報告事項|ほうこくじこう} (items for report only). The distinction is important for corporate governance and legal compliance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {決議事項|けつぎじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deliberate on items for resolution
- {決議事項|けつぎじこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}める→含める：02408_fukumeru⟧: to include in the items for resolution
- {決議事項|けつぎじこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧: approval of resolutions
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧{決議事項|けつぎじこう}: ordinary resolution items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {報告事項|ほうこくじこう}: items for report — agenda items presented for information only, not requiring a vote
- ⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧: resolution, vote — the act of formally deciding; {決議事項|けつぎじこう} refers to the items being decided
- ⟦{議案|ぎあん}→議案：20813_gian⟧: bill, proposal, motion — a specific proposal put before a meeting for consideration
- ⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧: agenda item — a broader term for any item on a meeting's agenda
